name: City of Graz – Historic Centre and Schloss Eggenberg
description: Graz, the capital of Styria in southern Austria, has one of Central Europe's best-preserved old towns, a tight cluster of Renaissance and Baroque streets, courtyards and red rooftops below the Schlossberg hill. It was long a Habsburg residence and a bulwark against the Ottomans. On the city's western edge, Schloss Eggenberg adds a grand aristocratic palace to the ensemble.
